extracted.name: Mackerel Dip
extracted.description: This simple mackerel dip mixes up in minutes with canned mackerel, mayonnaise, and basic seasonings, and it's ready after just two hours in the fridge.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can mackerel, drained and rinsed
1 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Remove and discard mackerel skin and bones. In a medium bowl, mix mackerel with onion and hot pepper sauce with a fork, breaking it into small pieces. Mix in mayonnaise, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
